Description: Administrator-applied access for one Paris Agent Gateway evaluation. Adds a bounded deployment policy to an existing role; creates no application or billable compute.

ProxyActivationBucket.Description: Set automatically by make aws-access-deploy from the application stack; the default is a nonfunctional placeholder.

ProxyAuthzApiId.Description: Set automatically by make aws-access-deploy from the application stack; the default is a nonfunctional placeholder.

ProxyGatewayLicenceObject.Description: Exact GatewayLicenceObject value used by the proxy.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Caps created Lambda roles even when deployment identity writes inline policies.
must: No direct IAM mutation or secret-management. Only scoped wizard child-stack lifecycle and PassRole to the fixed CloudFormation demo role.
Activation object keys must be under activation/.
Allow only EU Nova Micro inference; execution roles must separately grant access.

Properties.Description: Maximum permissions for Agent Gateway evaluation workloads; execution policies are narrower.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Extends the existing assumed developer role for evaluation deployment and cleanup, including read-only validation of the exact workload boundary. Regional read-only event discovery is separate because the stack-scoped grant did not authorize diagnostic requests. HTTP API stage provisioning requires explicit API Gateway tag actions in addition to HTTP method permissions.
must: Administrator reviews and applies this stack separately.
No ability to edit this policy, the workload boundary, or the developer role.
API IDs and Cognito pool IDs are unknown until creation; regional scopes need review.
TagResource/UntagResource match the live API Gateway Stage provider; W3037 is suppressed here because the lint IAM action catalog omits them.

Properties.Description: Evaluation deployment and cleanup, not a general administrator policy.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Grants scoped proxy-network creation and cleanup permissions for the optional proxy VM.
must: Administrator reviews and applies this stack separately.
No ability to modify the deployment role or other managed policies.
Network creation and cleanup are constrained by resource types and exact resource tags.

Properties.Description: Scoped VPC and Internet Gateway lifecycle permissions for the optional proxy deployment.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Caps the optional proxy EC2 role to Systems Manager and the proxy application's exact data-plane resources.
must: The proxy role must retain this boundary.
Do not add IAM or deployment mutation permissions.
Keep runtime access limited to the SSM managed-node APIs and the proxy's exact application resources.

Properties.Description: Maximum permissions for the optional Agent Gateway proxy EC2 role.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Lets the restricted deployer create and clean up only the bounded proxy role and its instance profile.
must: CreateRole must require ProxyRoleBoundary.
PassRole must be limited to the generated proxy role and EC2.
AttachRolePolicy must be limited to AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore.
Do not grant role trust-policy mutation or general IAM permissions.

Properties.Description: Scoped IAM role and instance-profile lifecycle for the optional proxy VM.

must: Administrator reviews and applies this stack separately.
No ability to edit this policy, the workload boundary, or the developer role.
API IDs and Cognito pool IDs are unknown until creation; regional scopes need review.

Properties.Description: Evaluation deployment and cleanup, not a general administrator policy.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: CloudFormation provisions wizard child PEP/backend stacks without giving web direct Lambda/IAM mutation permissions. Regional index-policy discovery is required by CloudFormation log-group validation and cannot be scoped to a log-group ARN. HTTP API stage provisioning requires explicit API Gateway tag actions in addition to HTTP method permissions.
must: Only demo-prefixed functions/logs and regional HTTP APIs.
Pass only existing application GatewayRole and EmotionBackendRole to Lambda.
Never create or mutate IAM roles or policies.
TagResource/UntagResource match the live API Gateway Stage provider; W3037 is suppressed here because the lint IAM action catalog omits them.

DemoDeploymentRoleArn.Description: Pass this role ARN into the application DemoDeploymentRoleArn parameter.
